items.title: Einspruch against income tax assessment 2025
items.quote: Die Einspruchsfrist beträgt einen Monat und rechnet ab der Bekanntgabe; ein Bescheid, der als Brief verschickt wird, ist am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden als bekannt gegeben anzusehen.
items.computation: Letter posted/dated Thu 19.11.2026. Posted on or after 1 Jan 2025 → delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting, counting calendar days: day 1 = Fri 20.11., day 2 = Sat 21.11., day 3 = Sun 22.11., day 4 = Mon 23.11.2026. For tax offices, if that 4th day is a Sat/Sun/holiday it would move to the next working day, but 23.11.2026 is a normal Monday, so deemed delivery = Mon 23.11.2026. Einspruch period is one month after delivery (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO, counted per § 108 Abs. 1 AO / §§ 187, 188 BGB): the delivery day itself does not count as day 1; the one-month period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23 December 2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Bremen, so no further shift applies.
